schema.title: Response List Scheduled Activities Api V1 Autonomy Schedule  Get

post.description: Create a new scheduled background activity.

Run a full research workflow: search → browse → extract → store.

Results are stored in memory with provenance tracking. High-credibility
results can optionally be stored as knowledge items.
Search the web using configured provider.
Fetch and extract content from a single web page.
Search via DuckDuckGo browser, then browse top results.
Cross-reference a knowledge item against multiple sources.

Convert uploaded audio to text.

Accepts WAV, MP3, or other common audio formats.
Convert text to speech audio (returns base64-encoded audio).
Detect voice activity in uploaded audio.

Analyze an uploaded image using Qwen3.5 multimodal.

Optionally store the findings in long-term memory with provenance.

Analyze an uploaded video by sampling frames.

Video is NOT permanently stored - only analysis findings are kept.
